title: How Fast the Path Can Be Driven: A Speed for Every Point, Within the Grip of a Turn, the Brakes Before It, and the Stop Line

questions.question: What does the backward pass of a speed profile do?
options: Limits each speed to what the vehicle could still slow down from to reach the next point
questions.explanation: It puts the brakes on before the bend.

questions.question: The capped speeds alone asked for a deceleration of:
questions.explanation: The brakes must start before the bend.

questions.question: The profile asked for how much, against a limit of 1.5?
How far before the stop line did the slowing begin?
The same path took how long on ice, against tarmac?
options: 8.0 s on ice against 5.9 s on tarmac

questions.question: Why did smoothing a corner save time?
options: The curvature at the corner point was lower, so the cap was higher: 8.6 s to 8.2 s
